I arrived at this grooming salon with my husband and our dog to check the information displayed in the window and see if we wanted to use this groomer's services.

While we were standing in front of the window, a woman came to the door and locked it in front of us. She never came out to inform us that the salon was closed, nor even to ask if we needed any information, even though a dog was being groomed inside.

I found this action particularly disrespectful and unprofessional. We were potential new customers who simply wanted to get some information. Even if the salon was closed, the least they could have done was politely inform us, rather than locking the door without a word and leaving us with the impression that we were unwelcome guests.

First impressions are extremely important for a business, and this experience unfortunately gave us a very negative impression of this establishment. There is a respectful way to treat people, even when you can't see them right away.

Personally, I certainly won't be using this groomer's services. If this is how potential clients are treated before they've even had a chance to use her services, it doesn't inspire any confidence in me going forward.

It's a shame, because we were there precisely to ask questions and consider becoming new clients.
Very attentive and personalized service; I received excellent service at this grooming salon, thank you.
No complaints. Clean, punctual, professional. I was wary, as usual, but the service was very satisfactory and quick.

They treated my senior pup with so much love. They did a great job on his cut. It was more inexpensive than other shops with a more personal experience. I will definitely be back. They were wonderful!

I've been bringing my Maine Coon to Le Barkershop for about 2 years now to be groomed by Marling and the grooming assistant Vanessa. They provide excellent service, my cat does not like to be handled and they are always making sure that they do not stress him too much. The salon itself is pretty clean for a grooming salon and the prices are very reasonable.

I paid $60 for their touch-up service.

All I wanted was for them to remove the hair in front of my dog's eyes.

My dog ​​still has a lot of hair in front of his eyes, and now I have to find another groomer to redo the trim.

$60 down the drain.
Very satisfied!!!
Extremely satisfied with the work done on Toby! Very courteous and professional staff.

It's not easy to properly groom a Siberian Husky, especially a young buck like our Penny. She came out looking like a true show dog, her undercoat was thoroughly groomed, the matted fur around her legs was taken care of and she was smelling great! The shampoo used is quite delicate which is nice because the smell isn't at all overwhelming. 10/10, it's expensive but absolutely worth the money. Could not be happier! :)
Excellent service for grooming my cat on February 2nd, 2026
Excellent service

We are always very happy with Cielo's grooming 🐶✨
He always comes out clean, handsome, and smells amazing!

A huge thank you to Camilo who takes such good care of him. You can tell he truly loves animals ❤️

Cielo is always happy to go, and so are we!

I highly recommend them 💯

I feel completely at ease leaving my fur babies in such a safe and caring environment! Maria and her team are truly amazing—so loving, attentive, and professional. The grooming services are exceptional as well!!! Highly recommend!
Poppy's favorite place. The owner is very professional and transparent. My dog's joy when she arrives is a reflection of the care he receives.
Professional service and friendly staff! I highly recommend The Barker Shop!
The place is very clean, the staff are very friendly and they give my little dog Maya a great haircut.
Faithful to my post every summer and always satisfied with the service and the haircut for Mr. Croquette ☺️ And as a bonus, a gift he greatly appreciates 👌🏼 …

We've always had excellent service and the grooming was always great. But the day after our last grooming appointment, we had a few too many problems. Our dog had conjunctivitis. She had pain in one of her front paws. We noticed that two of her paw pads had been cut, one of them more deeply (which ended up tearing). On the same paw, a claw became infected. Our dog, who walks on three legs, had an accident on the stairs, which apparently caused a fibrocartilaginous embolism in one of her hind legs (still not fully recovered after two months; she's still limping). We asked if everything was alright, and we were told "yes." Had we known about the accidental cutting of the paw pads, we would have taken precautions. So, we won't be going back.

It was the first time I'd taken my cat to be groomed, I was afraid they'd hurt him, but a lady came to reassure me and about 30 minutes later, "WOW, HOW BEAUTIFUL!!!" is what I said when they gave me back my blondie 😻 …

A very friendly team, always pleasant on the phone or in person, and very accommodating! I have an English Cocker Spaniel whose long, dense coat isn't easy to groom, but Mary Eve always does it with care. I appreciate that she discusses our expectations before grooming the dog (leg length, desired cut, etc.). In short, I highly recommend them; thank you for the excellent service for over two years!
My girlfriend took our Yorkie to get groomed. He's a handsome boy, looking brand new.
Love this place, they make my dog feel very comfortable and they do an excellent job
Albert is always very happy with his experience at Barker shop! 😍 Impeccable service! …
Flawless. Great groomer Marling!!!
All the staff are really kind and very professional. My dog ​​and I love this place and we would never change it.

I was warmly welcomed and received good care during the first two visits, but the third visit left much to be desired; everything changed... we went from 5 stars to just 1... I tried to understand, and apparently Lucky's groomer is no longer part of the team according to their website. Instead of canceling her appointments, they kept them all, which also explains the dog hair in the grooming area, something I've never seen before... A poorly resolved problem results in an unsatisfied customer... Oh well...
They do an amazing job! My Teddy always looks so good after grooming, thanks to Marling! Love this place!
Excellent service, patient and professional, thank you for grooming Riley!!!
Good quick service. Very kind and sweet employees

First haircut for my big guy! Very happy with the result! Plus, I was able to book an appointment for both my dogs at the same time. The woman on the phone was very kind, explained everything about puppy haircuts, and guided me through the process of getting both dogs groomed at the same time! My dogs came out looking great! So pleased!

I'm giving it 4 stars because I left with a bill of $230, so it's not cheap! But it's still a big job and a good job, so it's okay!

Excellent service! Very kind and handled our dog well!

Marling's service is excellent. She takes care of my dog ​​as if he were her own.
Snow, my Golden Retriever, loves being pampered by Marling. He has never …
